blocks.label: BPTT train step with clip and SGD

risks: Eval forward in <module>.validate (language_translation/main.py:173) runs without torch.no_grad(); activations for backward are kept
Eval batch 10 is 5x the train batch
Trains for 2 epochs, so every document repeats 2 times; repeated low-quality data costs more than unique data (give per-document quality scores for the repetition view)
Default path uses manual SGD via p.data.add_ instead of an optimizer, bypassing torch.optim state and momentum.
Learning-rate variable lr is annealed by lr /= 4.0 but manual update uses alpha=-lr while AdamW path uses args.lr, so schedules diverge.
Model type defaults to LSTM with no attention heads; supplied partial map claiming t5-base and hf_trainer is wrong.
Supplied partial-map knob locations point to unrelated distributed, vision, and GNN examples, not this entrypoint.
Training loads full corpus into memory with torch.cat and has no num_workers, packing, or checkpoint interval.
